card.name: Animal species profiles before habitat details
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words in species descriptions (animals, plants) where the next words likely describe where it lives or its habits, such as habitat, range or behavior.

modes.label: Break before habitat text
modes.description: A comma, period or bar in a fact-sheet list of diet, size or life span, right before habitat or range information.
modes.example: Basic facts about common dinosaurs, such as what they eat<<,>> where they lived and their physical characteristics.

modes.label: Subject word in species description
modes.description: A pronoun or verb such as It or is after a description of an animal's body, leading into where it occurs.
modes.example: The Black Stingray<< is>> recorded from coastal and offshore waters of south

modes.label: Field-guide label boundary
modes.description: The end of a diet or habitat entry just before the next labelled field such as Behavior or Altitude.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of words like habitat, habitats, habits and inhabit coming next.
card.plain: It marks spots in animal or plant profiles where the text is about to say where the species lives or how it behaves.
